text: Capernaum, on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee.
Jesus was home — and the word got out.
By the time four men came up the street carrying their friend on a sleeping mat, one at each corner, the house he was teaching in had already swallowed half the town.
The man on the mat was paralyzed.
He could not walk to Jesus.
So the people who loved him decided he would get there anyway.
